Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Frondator
Clan: Tremere antitribu (group 4)
Capacity: 5
Disciplines: AUS dom tha
Sabbat bishop: Rescuing a vampire from torpor costs Frondator 1 less blood.

Okay. We had some discussion yesterday about Frondator. Since the card clearly sayes that Frondator pays 1 less, can you still make her rescued vampire pay the full 2 blood? Would the cost ration be like this:

F 0-1=0 blood /Rescued 2 blood
F 1-1=0 blood /rescued 1 blood
F 2-1=1 blood /rescued 0 blood

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Baaliprimogen wrote:
> Frondator
> Clan: Tremere antitribu (group 4)
> Capacity: 5
> Disciplines: AUS dom tha
> Sabbat bishop: Rescuing a vampire from torpor costs Frondator 1 less blood.
>
> Okay. We had some discussion yesterday about Frondator. Since the card clearly sayes that Frondator pays 1 less, can you still make her rescued vampire pay the full 2 blood? Would the cost ration be like this:
>
> F 0-1=0 blood /Rescued 2 blood
> F 1-1=0 blood /rescued 1 blood
> F 2-1=1 blood /rescued 0 blood
>
The cost of the action is reduced by 1. 2-1 = 1, there's 1 blood to be spent.
Similarly, see Miriam's ruling:  [LSJ 20020304] .
